name: KasuMeta
description: Stores localized metadata beside Jellyfin (its own SQLite file) and serves it to client apps through /KasuMeta endpoints: titles, overviews, taglines and artwork per locale from TMDB, TVDB or both (by priority weight), anime titles from AniList, search by localized name, and admin overrides. Stock clients are unaffected. Requires Jellyfin 12.x and a TMDB or TVDB API key.
overview: Localized titles, overviews and artwork for every user's language

versions.changelog: 1.1.0: TVDB as a metadata provider (API v4 key, plus PIN for user-supported keys). Choose TMDB only (the default, as before), TVDB only, or both with a priority weight each: per field, image and language the higher weight wins and the other fills the gaps. Changing the choice fetches the library again.

1.0.0: first release. Localized titles, overviews, taglines and artwork from TMDB, anime titles from AniList, search by localized name, admin overrides, and a status panel on the plugin page. Requires Jellyfin 12.x and a TMDB API key.
